Alex G.: Quick sync — we need to lock the deliverables and handoffs for the CloudWave marketplace integration. High level: launch blog + joint benchmark, partner webinar, and inbound lead mapping. Who's in?
Maya R.: I'm in. can we pick webinar date first?
Noor (CloudWave PM): Prefer week of May 13, mornings PT. Avoid the 15th — exec conflict.
Liam S.: May 14 or 16 mornings PT work for us.
Tara K.: May 16 looks best. I'll block a slot tentatively.
Alex G.: Cool. Action items: Maya (webinar content + speaker brief), Liam (benchmark narrative + data), Tara (ops + landing page), Ben (lead routing + CRM mapping), Noor (partner promo).
Maya R.: Draft outline: 1) integration overview 2) Live demo (10m) 3) Benchmark deep dive (15m) 4) Customer Q&A. Need 2 demo engineers from partner.
Noor (CloudWave PM): I'll confirm demo engineers by EOD tomorrow.
Liam S.: For benchmark narrative — we'll show cost/latency before vs after Redwood optimize + CloudWave connector. Need sample dataset from partner (50k tokens aggregate). Noor: sending S3 link now -> https://s3.console.aws/abc123
Maya R.: Great. For the blog/launch post: propose co-authored post with two hero graphs: product integration + benchmark highlights. Draft due May 6.
Tara K.: I'll spin up a landing page template. Quick question: do we want a gated CTA for partner leads, or straight to demo request?
Ben C.: Recommend gated form only for CloudWave-enterprise prospects; default to demo request CTA. I'll add routing rules in HubSpot.
Ben C.: Routing sketch (will add to CRM):
```
if lead.company_domain in cloudwave_enterprise_list -> assign to Partner-SE queue
else -> Redwood inbound SDR queue
```
Maya R.: Also want to capture benchmark consent checkbox and a hidden utm=cloudwave param.
Alex G.: Nice. Also need joint webinar promotional cadence: announce email, 2 reminder emails, partner social push, paid ads. Maya, Noor coordinate the asset list by May 3.
Noor (CloudWave PM): We'll prepare partner email copy + social cards. Can you share logo + integration screenshots?
Tara K.: I'll export screenshots tomorrow and put in /marketing/assets/cloudwave-folder.
Liam S.: Data validation: I'll run the first pass of benchmark scripts tonight, pinging if anything odd.
Maya R.: Speaker brief: short bullets for each speaker (5 max). I'll draft and share by tomorrow morning.
Alex G.: Risks: 1) demo flake 2) benchmark sample delay 3) routing not tested -> Plan: run dry-run w/ partner 48h before; QA benchmark by May 10; test routing in staging. Tara & Ben own dry-run.
Tara K.: Noted, scheduling dry-run for May 14 10am PT.
Ben C.: I'll set up a test webhook + form in staging and post results in this thread when done.
DemoBot: Reminder: calendar invite created for 2024-05-16 10:00 PT — attendees: Alex G., Maya R., Liam S., Tara K., Noor (CloudWave PM).
Alex G.: Perfect. Final ask: everyone add their deliverable to the shared checklist in Notion (Marketing > Partnerships > CloudWave integration) by EOD. I'll follow up tomorrow with a compressed timeline. :thumbsup:
